def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place large models first, then apply the best improving single move, swap, or paired move."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True):
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if model.model_size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf"),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= model.model_size
        load[best] += model.req_rate / model.slo

    for _ in range(len(models) * 2):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        score, action = max(ratios), None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size, pressure = model.model_size, model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    remaining = free[dst] - size
                    candidate = max(
                        (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size) if i == src
                        else (load[dst] + pressure) / remaining if i == dst and remaining
                        else float("inf") if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if candidate < score:
                        score, action = candidate, ("move", src, dst, model)

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for dst in range(src + 1, gpu_num):
                for a in placement[src]:
                    sa, pa = a.model_size, a.req_rate / a.slo
                    for b in placement[dst]:
                        sb, pb = b.model_size, b.req_rate / b.slo
                        fs, fd = free[src] + sa - sb, free[dst] + sb - sa
                        if fs < 0 or fd < 0:
                            continue
                        candidate = max(
                            (load[src] - pa + pb) / fs if i == src and fs
                            else (load[dst] - pb + pa) / fd if i == dst and fd
                            else float("inf") if i == src or i == dst else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if candidate < score:
                            score, action = candidate, ("swap", src, dst, a, b)

        # A pair can be jointly beneficial even when either model alone would
        # overload the destination or fail to reduce the current maximum.
        for src in range(gpu_num):
            items = placement[src]
            for x in range(len(items)):
                a = items[x]
                sa, pa = a.model_size, a.req_rate / a.slo
                for b in items[x + 1:]:
                    sb, pb = b.model_size, b.req_rate / b.slo
                    for dst in range(gpu_num):
                        if src == dst or sa + sb > free[dst]:
                            continue
                        remaining = free[dst] - sa - sb
                        candidate = max(
                            (load[src] - pa - pb) / (free[src] + sa + sb)
                            if i == src else
                            (load[dst] + pa + pb) / remaining
                            if i == dst and remaining else
                            float("inf") if i == dst else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if candidate < score:
                            score, action = candidate, ("pair", src, dst, a, b)

        if action is None:
            break
        if action[0] == "move":
            _, src, dst, model = action
            placement[src].remove(model)
            placement[dst].append(model)
            free[src] += model.model_size
            free[dst] -= model.model_size
            pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
            load[src] -= pressure
            load[dst] += pressure
        elif action[0] == "pair":
            _, src, dst, a, b = action
            placement[src].remove(a)
            placement[src].remove(b)
            placement[dst].extend((a, b))
            free[src] += a.model_size + b.model_size
            free[dst] -= a.model_size + b.model_size
            pressure = a.req_rate / a.slo + b.req_rate / b.slo
            load[src] -= pressure
            load[dst] += pressure
        else:
            _, src, dst, a, b = action
            placement[src].remove(a)
            placement[dst].remove(b)
            placement[src].append(b)
            placement[dst].append(a)
            free[src] += a.model_size - b.model_size
            free[dst] += b.model_size - a.model_size
            pa, pb = a.req_rate / a.slo, b.req_rate / b.slo
            load[src] += pb - pa
            load[dst] += pa - pb

    return placement

def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place large models first, then repeatedly choose the best improving move or swap."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True):
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if model.model_size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf"),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= model.model_size
        load[best] += model.req_rate / model.slo

    for _ in range(len(models) * 2):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        score, action = max(ratios), None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size, pressure = model.model_size, model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    remaining = free[dst] - size
                    candidate = max(
                        (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size) if i == src
                        else (load[dst] + pressure) / remaining if i == dst and remaining
                        else float("inf") if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if candidate < score:
                        score, action = candidate, ("move", src, dst, model)

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for dst in range(src + 1, gpu_num):
                for a in placement[src]:
                    sa, pa = a.model_size, a.req_rate / a.slo
                    for b in placement[dst]:
                        sb, pb = b.model_size, b.req_rate / b.slo
                        fs, fd = free[src] + sa - sb, free[dst] + sb - sa
                        if fs < 0 or fd < 0:
                            continue
                        candidate = max(
                            (load[src] - pa + pb) / fs if i == src and fs
                            else (load[dst] - pb + pa) / fd if i == dst and fd
                            else float("inf") if i == src or i == dst else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if candidate < score:
                            score, action = candidate, ("swap", src, dst, a, b)

        if action is None:
            break
        if action[0] == "move":
            _, src, dst, model = action
            placement[src].remove(model)
            placement[dst].append(model)
            free[src] += model.model_size
            free[dst] -= model.model_size
            pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
            load[src] -= pressure
            load[dst] += pressure
        else:
            _, src, dst, a, b = action
            placement[src].remove(a)
            placement[dst].remove(b)
            placement[src].append(b)
            placement[dst].append(a)
            free[src] += a.model_size - b.model_size
            free[dst] += b.model_size - a.model_size
            pa, pb = a.req_rate / a.slo, b.req_rate / b.slo
            load[src] += pb - pa
            load[dst] += pa - pb

    return placement

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

    all_kvpr = []

    avg_kvpr = np.mean(all_kvpr)
    if avg_kvpr != 0:
        avg_kvpr = 1.0 / avg_kvpr


    print(f"Max KVPR: {avg_kvpr:.3f}")
